class.name: VCSVParseOptions
class.brief_description:
Parser configuration (delimiter, quoting, comments, strictness, BOM...).
解析器配置（分隔符、引号、注释、严格性、BOM 等）。
class.description:
Pure data carrier passed to [VCSVParser]. [code]null[/code] options default to comma delimiter, double-quote quoting, headers enabled, trimming on and lenient row widths.
Create one, tweak the fields you need, and pass it to [method VCSVParser.parse_string] / [method VCSVParser.parse_file] (or to [method VCSVUtil.load_csv_dict_array] as the second argument):
[codeblock] var opts := VCSVParseOptions.new() opts.delimiter = ";" opts.comment_prefix = "#" opts.encoding = "gbk" var result := VCSVParser.parse_file("res://data/items.csv", opts) [/codeblock]
传给 [VCSVParser] 的纯数据载体。[code]null[/code] options 默认逗号分隔、双引号引号、启用表头、开启修剪、宽松行宽。
创建一个实例，按需调整字段，再传给 [method VCSVParser.parse_string] / [method VCSVParser.parse_file]（或作为第二参数传给 [method VCSVUtil.load_csv_dict_array]）：
[codeblock] var opts := VCSVParseOptions.new() opts.delimiter = ";" opts.comment_prefix = "#" opts.encoding = "gbk" var result := VCSVParser.parse_file("res://data/items.csv", opts) [/codeblock]

members.member:
Field separator (single character; also works as a DSV delimiter, e.g. tab or semicolon). Must be a single code point — a multi-character delimiter is rejected as a parse error (e.g. [code]"||"[/code]).
字段分隔符（单字符；也可作为 DSV 分隔符，如制表符或分号）。必须是单码点——多字符分隔符会被当作解析错误拒绝（如 [code]"||"[/code]）。

Quote character. Default is the double quote. Fields containing the delimiter, a quote or a line break are quoted; an embedded quote is doubled (`""` inside quotes is one literal quote).
引号字符。默认双引号。含分隔符、引号或换行的字段会被加引号；内部引号双写（引号内的 `""` 是一个字面引号）。

Lines whose first field starts with this character are skipped. Empty (default) = no comment lines. Only the very first character of the record is tested, so a quoted field starting with the prefix is not a comment.
首个字段以该字符开头的行会被跳过。空（默认）= 无注释行。只检测记录的首字符，因此以该前缀开头的引号字段不算注释。

Trim leading/trailing whitespace of unquoted fields only. Quoted content is preserved verbatim (`" x "` stays ` x `).
仅修剪未加引号字段的首尾空白。引号内容原样保留（`" x "` 保持 ` x `）。

[code]true[/code] = a row with a different field count than the first row is a hard error; [code]false[/code] = pad/truncate with a warning.
[code]true[/code] = 行宽与首行不一致即硬错误；[code]false[/code] = 补齐/截断并警告。

Skip completely empty records.
跳过完全空白的记录。

Strip a leading UTF-8 byte order mark. The BOM is removed at the byte level before decoding, so it never pollutes the first header cell.
剥离开头的 UTF-8 字节序标记。BOM 在解码前于字节层移除，因此不会污染第一个表头单元格。

Whether the first data row is a header row (stored separately by [VCSVTable]). Set [code]false[/code] to treat every row as data (headers will be empty and row dicts use numeric keys).
首行是否为表头行（由 [VCSVTable] 单独存储）。设为 [code]false[/code] 则所有行都是数据行（表头为空，行字典用数字键）。

Reserved — currently unused. Case-insensitive column↔property matching in typed binding is controlled by [member VCSVDataTable.case_insensitive_columns].
预留——当前未使用。类型化绑定中列名与属性的不区分大小写匹配由 [member VCSVDataTable.case_insensitive_columns] 控制。

Hard-error budget (0.4.0). In strict mode, structural problems (row width mismatch, stray quote, junk after a quoted field) are counted: parsing continues past each one — the row is normalized and the error recorded as a [code]line:col error: ...[/code] warning — until [code]max_errors[/code] is reached, then aborts. A strict parse with any hard error still fails overall. [code]0[/code] = unlimited. Unterminated quotes are always fatal immediately.
硬错误预算（0.4.0）。strict 模式下，结构问题（列数不匹配、游离引号、引号字段后的杂字符）会被计数：解析越过每个错误继续（该行被规范化、错误记为 [code]line:col error: ...[/code] 警告），直到达到 [code]max_errors[/code] 才中止。含任何硬错误的 strict 解析最终仍判失败。[code]0[/code] = 不限。未闭合引号始终立即致命。

Skips this many data rows after the header before keeping rows (slicing). Useful for loading a slice of a huge file: [code]row_offset[/code] + [member max_rows].
保留前先跳过表头后的这么多数据行（切片）。用于只加载大文件的一部分：[code]row_offset[/code] 配合 [member max_rows]。

Keeps at most this many data rows (0 = unlimited). Pairs with [member row_offset] to load a slice of a large file.
最多保留这么多数据行（0 = 不限）。与 [member row_offset] 配合可只加载大文件的一部分。

When true, the delimiter is auto-detected from the first ~8 records by quote-aware width consistency across [member delimiter_candidates]. Overrides [member delimiter]. Quote-aware means commas inside quoted fields don't break the detection (e.g. `"x,y",1` still detects comma).
为 true 时，根据 [member delimiter_candidates] 上的引号感知宽度一致性，从前 ~8 条记录自动检测分隔符。会覆盖 [member delimiter]。引号感知指引号内的逗号不会干扰检测（如 `"x,y",1` 仍能检出逗号）。

Single-code-point candidate delimiters tried by [member auto_detect_delimiter]. Default [code]",;\t|"[/code].
[member auto_detect_delimiter] 尝试的单码点候选分隔符。默认 [code]",;\t|"[/code]。

Number of leading rows that form the header. When > 1 they are joined with [member header_join] into one header row (multi-level headers). For example with `header_rows = 2` and `header_join = "."`, the two header rows `Level,Level,Name` / `Health,Attack,-` become `["Level.Health", "Level.Attack", "Name.-"]`.
组成表头的起始行数。> 1 时用 [member header_join] 连接为一个表头行（多级表头）。例如 `header_rows = 2`、`header_join = "."` 时，两行表头 `Level,Level,Name` / `Health,Attack,-` 变成 `["Level.Health", "Level.Attack", "Name.-"]`。

Separator used to join multi-level header rows (see [member header_rows]).
用于连接多级表头行的分隔符（见 [member header_rows]）。

When non-empty, header cells of the form [code]name<sep>Type[/code] (e.g. [code]hp:int[/code]) are split: the annotation is stripped from the header name and the declared type is exposed via [member VCSVParseResult.column_types] and used by [method VCSVUtil.load_csv_dict_array]. Default empty (off) so plain headers containing the separator are never mangled. Invalid type names fall back to [code]string[/code].
非空时，形如 [code]名称<分隔符>类型[/code]（如 [code]hp:int[/code]）的表头会被拆分：注解从表头名剥离，声明的类型经 [member VCSVParseResult.column_types] 暴露，并被 [method VCSVUtil.load_csv_dict_array] 使用。默认空（关闭），避免含分隔符的普通表头被误改。无效类型名回退为 [code]string[/code]。

File encoding for [method VCSVParser.parse_file]: [code]utf8[/code] (default), [code]gbk[/code] or [code]gb2312[/code]. GBK/GB2312 decode covers the GB2312 core + common GBK characters (lead byte 0xA1-0xF7); unknown bytes become U+FFFD. A stray UTF-8 BOM in a GBK file is still stripped.
供 [method VCSVParser.parse_file] 使用的文件编码：[code]utf8[/code]（默认）、[code]gbk[/code] 或 [code]gb2312[/code]。GBK/GB2312 解码覆盖 GB2312 核心 + 常见 GBK 字符（首字节 0xA1-0xF7）；未知字节变为 U+FFFD。GBK 文件中残留的 UTF-8 BOM 也会被剥离。
